capabilities: Convert typed block ids into links after pressing space or punctuation
Show suggestions for block links while typing
Match ids while ignoring capitalization, plurality, and dashes versus spaces
Restrict link targets to definitions in the current folder
Toggle Auto Link Mode and Suggestion Mode independently in settings
extras: Suggestion Mode is disabled by default; the plugin only scans markdown files in the same folder as the current document, so definitions outside the folder are unreachable.
problem: Creating links to block definitions in Obsidian requires manually writing link syntax, and typed ids can differ from the defined id in capitalization, plurality, and dashes versus spaces.
summary: Block-linking plugin that converts typed block ids into links to their definitions, using automatic or suggestion-based modes.
